info.title: 物簿 Life Ledger API
info.description: Personal money and item lifecycle database based on Stockroom. One purchase transaction updates money, items, stock and history. CNY only. Bind to loopback by default. Optional AI Intake changes inventory only; use purchases to record expenses.

get.summary: Get supported categories and suggested values

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive name and notes search.

parameters.name: hide_out
parameters.description: Exclude zero-quantity items without changing inventory.

409.description: History-protected item

delete.description: Legacy-only items can be deleted with DISCARD history. Items linked to purchase or lifecycle records are protected; returns 409. Use finish/discard or durable status instead.

post.description: Absolute quantity produces ADJUST; legacy negative delta produces CONSUME. All changes are atomic with history. Legacy response remains Item.

get.description: Lists unprocessed inputs. This endpoint does not analyse files or modify inventory.

post.summary: Stage text or one temporary media upload
post.description: Stores one image, PDF, audio file, or short video for later processing. The file may be up to 100 MB, is deleted when marked reviewed, and expires after 24 hours.

post.summary: Stage a text capture or up to ten files as one AI inbox batch
post.description: Each uploaded file becomes an independent inbox entry under one batch ID. A batch may contain at most 10 files and 250 MB total; each file remains limited to 100 MB.

get.summary: Get entries grouped in one inbox batch

post.summary: Analyze queued entries in one batch
Apply every safe ready change in one batch
post.description: Each inventory write is atomic. Entries that conflict with inventory move to needs_review instead of being applied.

post.summary: Apply all safe ready inbox changes

patch.summary: Set analysis behavior for future batches
patch.description: Changing this setting never processes existing inbox entries.

patch.summary: Mark an intake entry pending or reviewed

post.summary: Correct and apply, or discard, one reviewed inbox entry

409.description: Corrected change still conflicts with inventory

post.summary: Analyze one staged inbox entry with local AI
post.description: Processes text commands, images, PDFs, audio, and short videos into persisted review-only suggestions. It never changes inventory.

422.description: The inbox entry is not pending or its media could not be prepared

502.description: Local AI returned an invalid result or failed while processing

503.description: Local AI or local transcription is disabled or unavailable

post.summary: Analyze every pending inbox entry without an analysis

post.description: Each entry applies atomically. Unclear or unsafe entries remain pending.

post.summary: Analyze and apply the complete pending inbox
